title: We Rest on Thee
lyrics_original: We rest on Thee our Shield and our Defender!
We go not forth alone against the foe;
Strong in Thy strength, safe in Thy keeping tender,
We rest on Thee, and in Thy Name we go,
Strong in Thy strength, safe in Thy keeping tender,
We rest on Thee, and in Thy Name we go.
Yea, in Thy Name, O Captain of Salvation!
In Thy dear Name, all other names above:
Jesus our Righteousness, our Sure Foundation,
Our Prince of Glory and our King of Love,
Jesus our Righteousness, our Sure Foundation,
Our Prince of Glory and our King of Love.
We go in faith, our own great weakness feeling,
And needing more each day Thy Grace to know:
Yet from our hearts a song of triumph pealing,
We rest on Thee, and in Thy Name we go,
Yet from our hearts a song of triumph pealing,
We rest on Thee, and in Thy name we go.
We rest on Thee, our Shield and our Defender!
Thine is the battle, thine shall be the praise
When passing through the gates of pearly splendor,
Victors, we rest with Thee through endless days,
When passing through the gates of pearly splendor,
Victors, we rest with Thee through endless days.

bible_verses.english: He will cover you with his pinions, and under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is a shield and a rampart.
I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption:

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, You are my Shield, my Defender, and my Sure Foundation. When I am tempted to rely on my own strength, help me to rest deeply in Yours. I step into this day taking comfort in Your tender keeping and proclaiming Your name above every fear. Lead me forward as my King of Love, and let Your peace guard my heart. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When life feels like a battle we cannot fight alone, "We Rest on Thee" reminds us that our true strength is found in surrendering to Christ. Jesus is not only our defender; He is our sure foundation and the Captain of our salvation. As we face life's uncertainties, this song invites us to step forward not in our own fleeting power, but wrapped in His tenderness and authority. Today, take a deep breath and rest in His name, knowing He goes before you in love.
